t: This is the Victoria Miro Gallery, a British contemporary art gallery. It's named after Victoria Miro, a British art dealer described as one of the grandes dames of the Britart scene. She runs it with her business partner Glenn Scott-Wright. Miro opened her first gallery in 1985 on Cork Street, then moved to larger premises in Islington in 2000, and later opened a second space in St George Street, Mayfair.
